name: In 90 Days (Humanitarian Leadership Academy)
description: Free online serious game by the Humanitarian Leadership Academy simulating humanitarian response scenarios across three crisis contexts (refugee crisis, earthquake, and conflict-affected area). Available in four languages. Designed for humanitarian workers to develop decision-making and leadership skills under time pressure and uncertainty.
domain: humanitarian response, refugee response, disaster relief, conflict response
reputation: established free training resource of the Humanitarian Leadership Academy; widely used in humanitarian sector
notes: Free online game available in English, French, Spanish, and Arabic. Three distinct scenarios covering different crisis types. Designed for self-directed learning as well as facilitated group training.
